task_management.hero_h1a: A Production Doesn't Need More Tasks.
task_management.hero_sub: Film productions are full of moving pieces. Departments preparing equipment, producers coordinating logistics, directors refining creative decisions. Everyone is busy. Yet no one sees the full picture.
task_management.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having tasks.
task_management.problem_desc: Most productions rely on improvised systems to manage tasks. Each system works on its own. Together, they create confusion.
task_management.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
task_management.problem_q2: Is it finished? Has it even started?
task_management.problem_q4: Which version is the right one?
task_management.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which one is current.
task_management.problem_bottom: This is not a productivity problem. It is a coordination problem.
task_management.core_desc: One platform. The complete production task lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from assignment to completion — in one connected workspace.
task_management.core_feat1_desc: Tasks live inside the same environment as scripts and schedules. No separate tool, no context switching.
task_management.core_feat2_desc: Every task has a named owner connected to a real department, not just a name in a spreadsheet.
task_management.core_feat3_desc: Dates reflect actual production timing because they exist inside the scheduling context.
task_management.core_feat4_desc: AI surfaces dependencies and helps prioritise based on production structure. Humans still make the calls.
task_management.context_title: A task isn't just a reminder.
task_management.context_desc: When task management lives inside the production environment, behaviour begins to shift.
task_management.context_card1_desc: Every task has a named owner connected to the actual work, not just a name in a spreadsheet.
task_management.context_card2_desc: Deadlines reflect actual production timing because they live inside the same scheduling context.
task_management.context_card3_desc: Teams spend less time checking status and more time completing the work that moves production forward.
task_management.context_card4_desc: Tasks stop being reminders — they become live signals that keep the whole production moving.
task_management.context_bottom_pre: Tasks stop being noise around the production.
task_management.context_bottom_highlight: They become part of the production itself.
task_management.context_banner_h1: Pzaz doesn't add another tool to the pile.
task_management.context_banner_h2: It puts tasks inside the production.
task_management.context_banner_desc: Task management should not be a separate app. It should be built into the same environment as your scripts, scenes, schedules, and planning.
task_management.craft_desc: Production teams have always organised work through lists, call sheets, and departmental planning.
task_management.craft_p1: Pzaz does not replace that discipline.
task_management.craft_p2: It simply provides a shared structure where assignments, updates, and progress remain visible to the entire team instead of scattered across tools.
task_management.craft_quote: The planning remains familiar. The coordination becomes far stronger.
task_management.shift_desc: When task management sits inside the production environment, behaviour shifts.
task_management.shift1_desc: Every task has a clear owner, so no one is left wondering who is responsible for what.
task_management.shift2_desc: Deadlines reflect actual production timing, not aspirational estimates disconnected from the schedule.
task_management.shift3_desc: Teams spend less time checking status and more time completing work that moves the production forward.
task_management.shift_bottom_highlight: They become signals that keep the whole production moving.
task_management.modern_desc: Wherever your team is, Pzaz keeps the whole production in sync.
task_management.modern_p1: Productions move quickly and often across locations, departments, and time zones. Pzaz keeps task coordination structured inside a cloud-based environment where everyone sees the same evolving state of the production.
task_management.modern_p2: Work moves forward with clarity instead of constant clarification.
task_management.modern_quote: Teams stay aligned. Momentum stays intact.
task_management.ai_desc: AI can generate lists quickly. But lists alone rarely coordinate a production.
task_management.ai_p1: Inside Pzaz, AI operates within the context of your project. It can assist with organising tasks, surfacing dependencies, and helping teams prioritise work based on production structure.
task_management.ai_p2: It does not decide what should happen next. That remains the responsibility of producers and department heads.
task_management.ai_quote: AI simply helps teams stay organised while all decisions remain human.
task_management.usps_desc: Every capability is designed for producers, line producers, production managers, and department heads who need tasks to reflect production reality.
task_management.usp1_desc: Assign tasks clearly across departments so every piece of work has a named owner connected to the production.
task_management.usp1_highlight: No more 'I thought you were handling that.' Ownership is explicit, visible, and tied to the work.
task_management.usp2_desc: Track deadlines and milestones that reflect actual production timing, not arbitrary dates in a to-do app.
task_management.usp2_highlight: Dates mean something because they exist inside the same scheduling context as the rest of production.
task_management.usp3_desc: Organise work using boards and priority lists that reflect the real rhythm of pre-production and principal photography.
task_management.usp3_highlight: Every department sees their own lane. Leadership sees the whole picture.
task_management.usp4_desc: Plan focused work periods designed for the production rhythm — week-by-week, prep phase by prep phase.
task_management.usp4_highlight: Teams know what this week looks like. Nothing important falls between the cracks.
task_management.usp5_desc: AI assists with organising tasks, surfacing dependencies, and helping teams prioritise based on production structure.
task_management.usp5_highlight: AI doesn't decide what happens next. It makes sure the people who do decide can see clearly.
task_management.usp6_desc: Task coordination stays connected to scripts, scenes, schedules, and planning — never drifting into an isolated tool.
task_management.usp6_highlight: When a scene changes, related tasks update. The production stays in sync automatically.
task_management.cta_desc: With Pzaz, you know what needs to happen, who is responsible, and how to keep the production moving forward.
